next_step_summary: Local provider run v3 after PR #261 produced the first usable semantic evidence: 9/10 cases completed, 5/5 candidate resolutions matched, one successful 3.5 fallback case, one malformed-JSON case, and recurring exact-score losses from response-contract mismatches such as P14D day strings, aggregation across mechanism IDs, and incorrect BLANK/HANDWRITING/MISSING dependency state or refs. PR #262 is a bounded diagnostic corrective: preserve explicit per-mechanism target assertion slots, clarify integer day/state/ref semantics, and request provider-enforced JSON structured output with an exact assertion-count bound. Models, corpus oracle, strict scorer, retry/failover, credentials and Question Engine production schema remain unchanged. Next step is local run v4 and comparison against run v3.
